title: Indefeasibility
summary: INDEFEASIBIL'ITY, noun [from indefeasible.] The quality or state of being not subject to be made void; as the indefeasibility of a title.

inlines.v: INDEFEASIBIL'ITY, noun [from indefeasible.] The quality or state of being not subject to be made void; as the indefeasibility of a title.
